## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) **prolegomenon** (*xuánshì* 懸示, "preliminary indications") to **Dátiān Tōnglǐ** 達天通理 [通理](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E7%90%86)'s ten-fascicle *Lèngyán jīng zhǐzhǎng shū* 楞嚴經指掌疏 ([KR6j0716](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0716)). Tōnglǐ identifies himself as *Jīngdū Niānhuásì Xiánzōng hòuxué Dátiān Tōnglǐ jìngshù* 京都拈華寺賢宗後學達天通理敬述 ("respectfully composed by Dátiān Tōnglǐ, junior disciple of the Xiánshǒu school at the Niānhuásì in the capital"), with editorial assistance from his Dharma-heirs [興宗祖旺](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%88%88%E5%AE%97%E7%A5%96%E6%97%BA) Xìngzōng Zǔwàng 興宗祖旺, [騰清懷仁](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A8%B0%E6%B8%85%E6%87%B7%E4%BB%81) Téngqīng Huáirén 騰清懷仁, and [祖毓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%96%E6%AF%93) Zǔyù 祖毓. Preserved as **X16 no. 307** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Xuánshì* lays out Tōnglǐ's programmatic framework for reading the *Śūraṃgama-sūtra*, **explicitly modeled on Qīngliáng Chéngguān** 清涼澄觀 [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) (the Táng Huáyán patriarch). He divides the sūtra into **four parts** corresponding to the *Sìzhǒngfēn* 四種分 of the Huáyán-school: (1) *Kāishì shēmó chéngxìn fēn* 開示奢摩成信分 ("Opening-and-revealing of *Śamatha*: bringing forth Faith"), (2) *Kāishì sānmó chéngjiě fēn* 開示三摩成解分 ("...of *Samādhi*: bringing forth Understanding"), (3) *Kāishì chánnà chéngxiū fēn* 開示禪那成修分 ("...of *Dhyāna*: bringing forth Cultivation"), (4) *Kāishì lèngyán chéngzhèng fēn* 開示楞嚴成證分 ("...of *Śūraṃgama*: bringing forth Realization"). The *Xuánshì* surveys the major Tang-Sòng *Lèngyán* commentarial tradition — [圓照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E7%85%A7) Yuánzhào, [子璿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%90%E7%92%BF) Chángshuǐ Zǐxuán, [無盡藏文殊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%84%A1%E7%9B%A1%E8%97%8F%E6%96%87%E6%AE%8A) Wújìnzàng Wénshū — and explicitly differentiates Tōnglǐ's reading from [交光真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BA%A4%E5%85%89%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91) Jiāoguāng Zhēnjiàn 交光真鑑's *Zhèngmài shū* ([KR6j0703](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0703)) — whose departures from Qīngliáng's Huáyán *jiāfǎ* 家法 Tōnglǐ regards as unacceptable. Composition: 1763 (癸未) — 1782 (Tōnglǐ's death).
